content.value_statement: RAG projects often fail because retrieval quality is weak or unmeasured. This skill guides chunking, embeddings, vector search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and evaluation choices.
actual_capabilities: Designs semantic chunking approaches using sentence boundaries, topic shifts, document structure, overlap, and metadata.
Explains hierarchical retrieval with paragraph, section, and document level indexes.
Combines BM25 or TF-IDF keyword retrieval with vector similarity.
Recommends Reciprocal Rank Fusion and query-specific score weighting.
Highlights reranking, relevance thresholds, retrieval evaluation, and embedding refresh practices.
Identifies RAG anti-patterns including fixed chunking, over-indexing, and ignored evaluation.
limitations: Does not provide a complete runnable RAG framework by itself.
Does not select a vector database without project requirements.
Requires source documents and evaluation goals to make precise recommendations.
Does not replace security review for production data pipelines.

use_cases.title: Plan a Knowledge Base RAG System
use_cases.description: Create a retrieval architecture for internal documents, including chunking, metadata, hybrid search, and quality checks.

use_cases.title: Improve Search Relevance
use_cases.description: Diagnose weak retrieval results and tune chunking, embeddings, reranking, filters, and relevance thresholds.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Retrieval Quality
use_cases.description: Separate retrieval evaluation from generation quality so teams can measure recall, precision, and context usefulness.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Basic RAG Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a RAG system for these documents: [document types]. Recommend chunking, metadata, embedding, and retrieval choices.

prompt_templates.title: Review Chunking Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my chunking plan for [content type]. Identify risks with boundaries, overlap, metadata, and context preservation.

prompt_templates.title: Tune Hybrid Retrieval
prompt_templates.prompt: My RAG system uses vector search and keyword search. Suggest a hybrid retrieval and reranking plan for [query patterns].

prompt_templates.title: Design Retrieval Evaluation
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an evaluation plan for my RAG retriever. Include test data, metrics, failure analysis, and refresh checks for changing documents.

output_examples.input: Design RAG for a support knowledge base with product manuals and tickets.
output: Recommended semantic chunks aligned to headings and troubleshooting steps.
Metadata filters for product, version, language, and document type.
Hybrid retrieval with reranking before sending context to the model.

output_examples.input: Our RAG answers are plausible but miss exact policy details.
output: Likely retrieval issue caused by weak metadata filtering or oversized chunks.
Add policy section identifiers, rerank top candidates, and evaluate retrieval separately.
Use relevance thresholds to avoid filling the prompt with weak matches.

output_examples.input: Evaluate whether retrieval quality improved after changing embeddings.
output: Build a query set with expected source passages and edge cases.
Measure recall, precision, reranker impact, and failure categories.
Compare results by content type before updating production embeddings.

best_practices: Preserve document structure and metadata during chunking.
Use hybrid retrieval when exact terms and semantic meaning both matter.
Measure retrieval quality separately before judging generated answers.
anti_patterns: Using fixed-size chunks that split sentences or sections.
Indexing every document without filtering low-value content.
Sending first-stage retrieval results directly to the model without reranking.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps plan and improve RAG systems that retrieve document context for language model answers.

faq.question: Can it choose an embedding model?
faq.answer: It can guide evaluation criteria, but final selection depends on content type, cost, latency, and test results.

faq.question: Does it support hybrid search?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers keyword retrieval, vector similarity, score fusion, metadata filters, and query-based weighting.

faq.question: Can it fix hallucinations?
faq.answer: It can improve retrieval quality and context selection, which reduces unsupported answers from the language model.

faq.question: Does it include production code?
faq.answer: No. It provides architectural guidance, review prompts, and evaluation direction for implementation work.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
